name: gram402
description: HTTP 402 payments for AI agents: GRAM on TON, PayPal spending mandates, NEAR mandate contracts. Clients and merchant paywalls, no dependencies.
author: Aleksandr Shcherbakov (https://github.com/miinimal)

scripts.build: npx -y esbuild@0.24.0 index.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && npx -y esbuild@0.24.0 index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && npx -y -p typescript@5.6.3 tsc globals.d.ts index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noCheck --target es2020 --module es2020 --moduleResolution node --lib es2020,dom --outDir dist
